report: Reviewed the complete current claim and sole implementation/test pair: the explicit region in sage_meta::todo and browser_serve_validates_and_hosts_on_loopback in test:spec_plan. Both remain TODO; the function has no assertions, and file-level guidance explicitly says passing placeholders are not behavioral evidence. The TODO covers argument/model/binding failure cases and a live-server check of URL, selected model, snapshot and shutdown. Accepted deferral accounts for validation and rendering before listening; loopback binding; reported URL opening the browser without another command; continued serving until stopped; integer port bounds 1..65535; optional input path; diagnostic and failing exit for bad arguments, invalid models and binding failures. The examples (port 3001 at http://127.0.0.1:3001/ and standalone browse HTML export) remain delivery requirements, not demonstrated behavior. Prerequisites for replacing this placeholder are CLI/model/render/server integration and a process-level live HTTP harness able to inspect diagnostics/status, choose input, provoke port-binding errors and terminate the server; tests must also establish standalone export. The declared deferral is sufficient and does not establish implementation completeness or executed live-server coverage. No helper dependencies are used by the empty body. Independently verified exact byte equality of the current whole spec_plan.rs with both historical implementation_sources and test_sources, and exact current/historical claim equality; reassessed rather than importing the prior verdict. Executed review start and byte-comparison inspection; no behavioral tests or build run by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 functional tests and cargo build passed, which is separate execution evidence and does not discharge this TODO. No source edits or additional source dependencies were needed.
